name: brain-kit
description: Second brain in OKF markdown, curated by Claude through pull requests: validator, pull request loop, Stop and SessionStart hooks, and skills to set up, capture, curate, ask, lint, review stale notes and approve.

vault_dir.title: Default vault directory
vault_dir.description: Vault used by brain-kit skills when the current directory is not a vault. Leave empty to require running inside the vault.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language for skill bodies and messages outside a vault (pt-BR or en). Inside a vault, brain-kit.config.json wins.
